ad: Inside a hotel room, a pair of young men are seated on a bed, both shirtless, with a doughnut box next to them. One man, sporting a chest tattoo of footprints and calligraphy, speaks energetically to the camera, consuming a doughnut. He uses hand gestures to stress his points and sometimes displays the doughnut up close. A casual and laid-back mood prevails as they chat about how many doughnuts they've consumed.
